ideas.hypothesis: Tariff liberalization and trade facilitation are complements: preferential tariff removal (such as AGOA) raises Sub-Saharan agricultural exports substantially only in countries with low border trade costs, and has little effect where border compliance time and cost are high.

sources.role: method/setting: gravity panel of agricultural exports from 35 AGOA-eligible countries to the US before and after AGOA
mechanism/finding: modest reductions in trade costs yield larger trade effects than ambitious market-access cuts
method: scenario-based assessment of multilateral liberalization using detailed protection data (MAcMaps)
mechanism: preferential arrangements can alter external protection, a possible confound for preference effects

ideas.test: PPML gravity panel of agricultural exports at HS6 level from SSA countries to the US and to other OECD markets, 1995-2015. Include an AGOA eligibility indicator interacted with exporter border compliance time/cost (World Bank Doing Business or the LPI customs score), with exporter-year, importer-year, and pair fixed effects.
ideas.disconfirming: The AGOA effect is the same regardless of border trade costs, or larger where trade costs are high.

ideas.hypothesis: NAFTA members bring fewer trade disputes against each other to the WTO than macroeconomic conditions would predict, because regional dispute mechanisms substitute for the WTO forum. This substitution weakens during macroeconomic downturns, when overall dispute initiation rises.

sources.role: mechanism/method: macroeconomic determinants (growth, income level) of WTO dispute initiation
method/finding: gravity evidence that NAFTA did not bias trade, so dispute patterns are not just trade-volume effects
setting: NAFTA's importance for US agricultural trade, a dispute-prone sector
mechanism: WTO free-trade stance clashes with domestic resource and labor concerns that generate disputes

ideas.test: Dyad-year panel of WTO dispute initiations (WTO dispute database) and NAFTA Chapter 19/20 panel requests, 1995-2019, for major trading pairs. Run a Poisson regression of WTO disputes on a NAFTA-pair indicator, complainant GDP growth and unemployment, real exchange rate changes, and log bilateral trade, with an interaction of NAFTA-pair and downturn.
ideas.disconfirming: NAFTA pairs file WTO disputes at the same rate as comparable non-RTA pairs, or the substitution does not vary with macroeconomic conditions.

ideas.hypothesis: TBT and SPS measures with environmental objectives (green barriers) cut the extensive margin of Chinese agricultural and forest product exports more than non-environmental TBTs do. The losses are smaller for exporting provinces with green-barrier early-warning and certification systems.

sources.role: method: framework for quantifying the trade impact of technical barriers
mechanism/setting: Anhui's institutional response (green-barrier early warning, standards) for agricultural exports
finding: forest products exports face traditional and emerging green barriers together
finding: technical barriers have a serious negative influence on Chinese foreign trade

ideas.test: Chinese customs data by province x HS6 x destination for agricultural and forest products, 2002-2015, merged with WTO TBT/SPS notifications classified by stated objective (environmental vs other). Estimate province-product-destination entry and exit probabilities, interacted with the timing of each province's adoption of early-warning systems.
ideas.disconfirming: Environmental TBTs have no larger effect than other TBTs, or provinces with early-warning systems suffer equal losses.

ideas.hypothesis: Trade facilitation that lowers border costs raises import penetration in import-competing sectors and thereby increases antidumping initiations, partly offsetting the trade gains that trade-facilitation reforms are predicted to deliver.

sources.role: mechanism/finding: reductions in trade costs generate large trade impacts
method: CGE scenario evaluation (Mirage) of Doha outcomes, which can be extended with endogenous trade remedy responses
method: global CGE assessment of Doha welfare effects including investment and scale effects

ideas.test: Country-sector-year panel for WTO members, 2005-2019: OECD Trade Facilitation Indicators or Doing Business import time/cost, sector import penetration, and antidumping initiations from the Global Antidumping Database. Estimate the effect of facilitation improvements on initiations, with the import surge as mediator, using country-sector and year fixed effects and TFA ratification timing as an instrument.
ideas.disconfirming: Trade facilitation improvements are followed by no change or a decline in antidumping initiations, even in sectors with import surges.

ideas.hypothesis: Export regions whose commodity structure is concentrated in resource-based and agricultural products lose more exports when destination markets impose green trade barriers. A diversified, more manufactured export basket buffers these losses.

sources.role: finding: green barriers hold back China's commodity exports
setting/finding: forest products' concentrated export markets and exposure to green barriers
measure: regional (provincial) structure of foreign trade and market diversification strategy
mechanism: shifts in commodity structure change exposure to technology and standards barriers

ideas.test: Chinese province x HS4 x destination exports, 2000-2015. Measure exposure as each province's pre-period export share in HS lines later hit by environmental SPS/TBT notifications. Run a difference-in-differences of export growth on exposure interacted with the province's export Herfindahl index.
ideas.disconfirming: Export losses from green barriers do not depend on concentration of the commodity structure.

ideas.hypothesis: Technical regulations on agricultural products act as a fixed-cost filter: they reduce new exporter-destination relationships but raise average volume and survival of incumbent relationships. The effect is larger for agricultural than for manufactured exports, and border carbon adjustments covering agri-food would have a similar margin pattern.

sources.role: finding/method: TBT reduces trade probability but raises volume and duration of existing relationships, decomposed into extensive and intensive margins
setting: technical barriers on Chinese agricultural exports
mechanism: border carbon adjustments and their dependence on producer responses
setting: agricultural export prospects as a trade policy concern

ideas.test: Chinese firm-level customs data (2000-2013) for agricultural and manufactured exports by destination, merged with destination TBT/SPS notifications. Estimate entry probability, value per surviving relationship, and survival hazard (Cox model) as functions of new notifications, interacted with an agricultural-product indicator.
ideas.disconfirming: Agricultural TBTs reduce both entry and the volume/survival of incumbents, or show no difference from manufactured goods.

ideas.hypothesis: Because WTO rules lack enforceable currency disciplines, an exporter's real undervaluation raises the probability that trading partners file WTO-consistent trade remedies (antidumping and safeguards) against it, especially in sensitive agricultural and manufacturing sectors. Pairs covered by TPP-style macroeconomic or currency declarations show a weaker undervaluation-remedy link.

sources.role: mechanism: monetary easing as unspoken currency manipulation and the gap in IMF/WTO disciplines
setting: industry push for currency manipulation provisions in the TPP
setting: agricultural sensitivity and protection pressures under the TPP
mechanism: agricultural protectionism and non-tariff barriers as policy responses

ideas.test: Importer-exporter-year panel, 1995-2019: bilateral real exchange rate misalignment (e.g., from Penn World Table price levels adjusted for income), trade remedy initiations from the Global Antidumping and Safeguards databases, and an indicator for pairs covered by the 2015 TPP Joint Declaration on macroeconomic policy. Run a Poisson regression with pair and year fixed effects.
ideas.disconfirming: Exporter undervaluation does not predict trade remedy filings, or the link is no weaker for pairs with currency declarations.

ideas.hypothesis: Holding the average tariff cut constant, negotiating rounds that used harmonizing (Swiss-type) formulas raised imports more in previously peak-protected product lines than rounds that used linear cuts. Formula choice thus shapes the distribution of liberalization gains across countries.

sources.role: mechanism/method: welfare comparison of proportional, Swiss and other formulas in a heterogeneous-firm model
setting: Kennedy Round linear-cut negotiations and the position of smaller agricultural exporters
method: CGE quantification of Doha Round welfare gains
finding: market access outcomes may be modest relative to trade cost reductions

ideas.test: Tariff-line data for the US and EC/EU across the Kennedy (linear) and Tokyo (Swiss formula) Round implementation periods, matched to import data at a concordable product level. Regress import growth on the tariff cut, interacted with the initial tariff level and a round indicator. Optionally simulate Doha formulas on current bound and applied tariffs.
ideas.disconfirming: The import response to cuts in high initial tariffs is no larger under the harmonizing-formula round than under the linear-cut round.

ideas.hypothesis: Bilateral negotiation substitutes for protectionist action: antidumping initiations against China by developing-country partners such as Mexico fall after bilateral agreements (textile MOUs, market-economy-status recognition, cooperation accords) compared with partners without such agreements.

sources.role: setting/finding: Mexico's intensive anti-dumping actions against China
mechanism: friendly negotiation and investment as responses to Sino-African textile trade friction
mechanism: asymmetric bargaining power shapes negotiated outcomes in GATT rounds
mechanism: political resurgence of mercantilist rhetoric as a driver of protection

ideas.test: Event study on the Global Antidumping Database, 1995-2019, of initiations against China by partner-year. Treatment events are bilateral agreements with China (market economy status recognition, textile MOUs, FTAs). Control partners never sign such agreements. Control for import surges from China and partner macro conditions.
ideas.disconfirming: Antidumping initiations against China do not fall, or rise, after bilateral agreements relative to control partners.

ideas.hypothesis: As a country's export commodity structure shifts toward knowledge- and technology-intensive goods, TBT-related frictions (specific trade concerns about regulations and intellectual property-linked standards) make up a growing share of the trade frictions it faces, relative to tariff and antidumping frictions.

sources.role: mechanism: in the knowledge economy, commodity structure changes and technical barriers and IP disputes become the main trade conflicts
finding: technical trade barriers increasingly affect Chinese foreign trade

ideas.test: Country-year panel, 1995-2019: technology intensity of the export basket (Lall classification applied to COMTRADE data); counts of TBT specific trade concerns raised against the country's products (WTO STC database) and of antidumping initiations. Regress the TBT share of frictions on technology intensity with country and year fixed effects.
ideas.disconfirming: The TBT share of trade frictions does not rise, or falls, as the technology intensity of exports increases.
